requirements.text: Persist prompt and generation identity before dispatch.
Stream ordered tokens with bounded replay and explicit resume gaps.
Fence cancellation and bound model admission and client buffers.

problem.scope: Authored emphasis is generated reply tokens, replay and cancellation, distinct from L004 human messaging. One million connections is a sizing target requiring measurement; no local model establishes that capacity.

provenance.note: Authored interview preparation. Technical references support mechanisms, not the claim that a company asked this question.

acceptanceCases.then: Return gap plus a permitted final snapshot, never silently concatenate a different attempt.
